retrievalProfile.description: A densely packed urban scene featuring a diverse cast of anthropomorphic animals in a vibrant, modern city setting with high-angle perspective.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bustling, high-detail 3D animated scene of a city street populated by various animal species in human clothing, featuring a prominent street sign and a crosswalk signal in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground street pole and signal framing the left side
Dense crowd of diverse animals receding into a deep city perspective
Tall, stylized urban architecture lining the street
Bright, natural daylighting with soft shadows
coreInvariants: Anthropomorphic animals of varying scales (giraffes to rodents) coexisting
Modern urban infrastructure adapted for animal use
Vibrant, saturated color palette with high detail in fur and fabric textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive crowd of characters occupies the lower two-thirds, with larger characters in the mid-ground and smaller ones in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The green rectangular street sign and yellow pedestrian signal on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the foreground signal, follows the crowd into the center, and then moves upward along the tall buildings toward the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited to the bright sky at the top center and small gaps between buildings.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones and vibrant primary colors from character clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blues and greys from the asphalt and glass buildings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and green from the traffic signals and signs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with bright, even values to maintain a cheerful tone.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with playful, organic modifications
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Z' features a sharp, dynamic diagonal
The 'O's are perfectly circular with thick strokes

composition.position: top center inside a green sign

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D animated urban street scene filled with a diverse crowd of anthropomorphic animals in clothing. Include a green rectangular street sign and a yellow traffic signal on a pole in the left foreground. Ensure bright daylight and deep perspective.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a custom, bold, rounded white sans-serif inside the green sign. Place secondary metadata text in a clean, wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the main title contained within the green sign?
Are the animals diverse in species and scale?
Is the lighting bright and consistent with a sunny day?

mustAchieve: Clear character silhouettes despite the crowd

Ensure the street sign perspective matches the scene
Verify that the text is legible and correctly centered
Confirm the color palette is vibrant and saturated
